messages:
Maya K: Heads-up — forecast shows ~28% uptick in tail GPU-hours for the promo window (Nov22-29). We need a short hedging plan to reduce fragmentation and keep SLAs. Proposals: temporary reserve in us-west, soft-preempt policy, and looser bin-packing for short jobs.
Samir: Numbers?
Maya K: Quick extract: base_gpuhrs=42,000, promo_bump≈11,800 (+28%). Model mix skew -> more short-llama 7b/13b sessions. frag_score baseline=0.12 -> projected +0.19 under current packer -> risk of ~12% extra preempts and 2-4% tail latency regressions.
Samir: can you drop the CSV? I want to run sims.
Maya K: attaching summary in drive, but here's what matters: hot pools concentrate on us-west; long-running jobs cause fragmentation when combined with many 1-2 min inference runs.
Kevin L: I like reserve + scheduler knobs. Two low-effort levers: enable slice-splitting for multi-card jobs (so 8p -> 4x2), and tighten evict_budget for background work. Also set soft_preempt to graceful-30s to reduce cold cache churn.
Kevin L: proposed canary config:
```json
{
  "evict_budget": 0.06,
  "slice_splitting": true,
  "soft_preempt": "graceful-30s",
  "reserve_regions": ["us-west1"]
}
```
Anya S: Re: cross-region fallback — APAC might spike too. If we reserve in us-west, we should add eu fallback with a hard cost cap so we don't blow budget. Also add tenancy hints so low-pri work bleeds to reserved pool.
Maya K: cost sketch: reserving 120 cards in us-west for 7 days = ~ $Xk (prelim). Compare: expected cost from extra preempts + SLA credits ~ $Yk plus customer impact. I'll post spreadsheet in a bit.
InfraBot: Deploy started: canary-reserve/us-west1 - 3 nodes (deploy id d-4523). ETA ~6m.
Samir: I'll run packer simulation matrix tonight: packer variants A/B/C, 100 seeds each, with and without reserve120 and slice-splitting. Expect initial metrics by EOD.
Kevin L: Also bump eviction smoothing window to 2m in canary to reduce oscillation. That reduced oscillations in last Q4 run.
Maya K: Action items:
- Samir: run sims with packer=B + reserve120 (due today EOD)
- Kevin: toggle slice_splitting + evict_budget canary tomorrow AM and monitor
- Anya: draft cross-region fallback policy + cost cap (today)
- Infra: monitor canary-reserve frag_score and preempt counts, webhook alerts to #eng-oncall
Anya S: ack, will include cost cap and fallback thresholds.
Samir: on it. Will post results as summary (short table).
InfraBot: Alert: canary-reserve/us-west1 frag_score=0.08, preempts=2 in last 10m — within expected.
Maya K: Thanks everyone — reconvene 16:30 in #eng-infra to review sim output and decide reserve sizing. :thumbsup:
